apk.notes: Settings → Delete My Account. A shop's only owner can save a copy of its inventory and transactions first (install this version of the app for that).

web.notes: Add From a Photo: in Outgoing Item(s), take a photo of the items going out, stickers up, and every item whose label is read is added. Green boxes show what was added. Then Scan What's Coming In opens Scan Cards.

desktop.notes: Transaction History always fills the window's width, so the search box and buttons line up with the list.
